description.en: Employee records, labor contracts, salary proposals and monthly payroll reviews.
description.zh-CN: 管理员工档案、劳动合同、薪酬变动和月度工资复核。

agentPrompts:
Compare salary proposals with confirmed employee salaries and prepare a payroll-review checklist without applying unapproved changes.
比较薪酬提案与员工已确认工资，拟定工资复核清单，不应用未批准的变动。

Review labor contracts expiring within 60 days and assign renewal follow-ups to their HR owners.
复核 60 天内到期的劳动合同，向其人事负责人分派续签跟进。
